He set the paper on the sill, weighted it with a shell, and climbed the stairs to polish the lens until it shone.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一个尚未醒透的人。路灯还亮着，光是旧的，落在空无一人的斑马线上。早点铺卷帘门哗啦一声拉开，蒸汽先于人声涌出街口。扫街的车慢慢驶过，水痕在柏油上留下一道发亮的河。写字楼只剩零星几格窗子未熄，不知是加班还是忘关。鸟声在梧桐里试了两声，又停下。远处第一班公交空着车厢转弯，像一只缓慢的鲸。天边泛起一线灰蓝，不是光，只是夜色稍稍松了手。这个时刻属于守夜的人和赶早的人，他们在街角互相点头，谁也不问对方从哪里来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to do most of the work.\n- Imagine standing in a long line and wanting to know your position: you ask the person ahead of you, they ask the person ahead of them, and the person at the front says \"I'm first\" — then the answers come back down the line, each adding one.\n- Every recursion needs a stopping point (like \"I'm first\"), or it keeps asking forever and never finishes."}
